description: Locais de recolha de resíduos de equipamentos elétricos e eletrónicos (REEE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Decree-Law No. º 152-D/2017, of 11 December, which unifies the regime for the management of specific waste streams subject to the principle of extended producer responsibility, approves the legal regime for the management of waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE), establishing measures to protect the environment and human health, with the objectives of preventing or ... Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The portal shows the English title as "Waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) collection sites" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Its keywords include apambiente-pt. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
